overview:
Enable the Datadog-Ceph integration to:

- Track disk usage across storage pools
- Receive service checks in case of issues
- Monitor I/O performance metrics

**Minimum Agent version:** 6.0.0
setup:
### Installation

The Ceph check is included in the [Datadog Agent][2] package, so you don't need to install anything else on your Ceph servers.

### Configuration

Edit the file `ceph.d/conf.yaml` in the `conf.d/` folder at the root of your [Agent's configuration directory][3].
See the [sample ceph.d/conf.yaml][4] for all available configuration options:

```yaml
init_config:

instances:
  - ceph_cmd: /path/to/your/ceph # default is /usr/bin/ceph
    use_sudo: true # only if the ceph binary needs sudo on your nodes
```

If you enabled `use_sudo`, add a line like the following to your `sudoers` file:

```text
dd-agent ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:/path/to/your/ceph
```

#### Log collection

_Available for Agent versions >6.0_

1. Collecting logs is disabled by default in the Datadog Agent, enable it in your `datadog.yaml` file:

   ```yaml
   logs_enabled: true
   ```

2. Next, edit `ceph.d/conf.yaml` by uncommenting the `logs` lines at the bottom. Update the logs `path` with the correct path to your Ceph log files.

   ```yaml
   logs:
     - type: file
       path: /var/log/ceph/*.log
       source: ceph
       service: "<APPLICATION_NAME>"
   ```

3. [Restart the Agent][5].

### Validation

[Run the Agent's status subcommand][6] and look for `ceph` under the Checks section.

metrics.name: ceph.apply_latency_ms
metrics.description: Time taken to flush an update to disks

metrics.name: ceph.class_pct_used
metrics.description: Per-class percentage of raw storage used

metrics.name: ceph.commit_latency_ms
metrics.description: Time taken to commit an operation to the journal

metrics.name: ceph.misplaced_total
metrics.description: Total number of objects if there are misplaced objects

metrics.name: ceph.num_objects
metrics.description: Object count for a given pool

metrics.name: ceph.op_per_sec
metrics.description: IO operations per second for given pool

metrics.name: ceph.osd.pct_used
metrics.description: Percentage used of full/near full osds

metrics.name: ceph.total_objects
metrics.description: Object count from the underlying object store. [v<=3 only]

serviceChecks.name: Ceph Status
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if your ceph cluster status is HEALTH_OK, `WARNING` if it's HEALTH_WARNING, `CRITICAL` otherwise.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph OSD Down
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if you have no down OSD. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph OSD Orphan
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if you have no orphan OSD. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph OSD Full
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if your OSDs are not full. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph OSD Near Full
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if your OSDs are not near full. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph Pool Full
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if your pools have not reached their quota. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph Pool Near Full
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if your pools are not near reaching their quota. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph PG Availability
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if there is full data availability. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph PG Degraded
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if there is full data redundancy. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph PG Degraded Full
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if there is enough space in the cluster for data redundancy. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph PG Damaged
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if there are no inconsistencies after data scrubing. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph PG Not Scrubbed
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if the PGs were scrubbed recently. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph PG Not Deep Scrubbed
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if the PGs were deep scrubbed recently. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph Cache Pool Near Full
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if the cache pools are not near full. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph Too Few PGs
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if the number of PGs is above the min threshold. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph Too Many PGs
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if the number of PGs is below the max threshold. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph Object Unfound
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` if all objects can be found. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph Request Slow
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` requests are taking a normal time to process. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.

serviceChecks.name: Ceph Request Stuck
serviceChecks.description: Returns `OK` requests are taking a normal time to process. Otherwise, returns `WARNING` if the severity is `HEALTH_WARN`, else `CRITICAL`.
